title: Extend BoundaryCondition IR slot with traction vector and surface tag
objective: Ensure the BoundaryCondition dataclass in mechdsl.ir.problem carries the traction vector and tagged surface set required for Neumann directive lowering.

plan_assets.asset_description: Risk note: BC IR slot may not currently carry surface-tag information; extend BoundaryCondition schema as part of this phase

scope: Extend BoundaryCondition dataclass slots: traction (Vec3 or array), surface_tag (str), and any associated validation
Validate at IR construction time per IR discipline (immutability, plan-phase rejection on unsupported)
Do not add unrelated BC types or fields
implementation_steps: Add traction (3-component vector) and surface_tag (str) fields with defaults preserving back-compat
Add validation: traction shape, surface_tag non-empty when bc_type == 'neumann'
Update any direct constructors in tests/lowering to pass new fields where Neumann BCs are built
Run unit tests on packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ir/ to confirm no regression
deliverables: Updated BoundaryCondition dataclass with traction + surface_tag fields
IR validation path covering Neumann case
acceptance_criteria: BoundaryCondition(bc_type='neumann', traction=[0,0,-1000], surface_tag='top') constructs without error
BoundaryCondition(bc_type='neumann') with no traction raises a validation error pointing to this phase

cases: Construct Neumann BC with traction + surface_tag
Construct Neumann BC missing traction → validation error

risks: Other call sites instantiate BoundaryCondition without new fields — mitigation: keep defaults so non-Neumann uses are unaffected (per plan line 113-115)

commands.command: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu' -q

completion_notes: Widened BoundaryCondition.traction to TractionT = str | tuple[float, float, float] | None
Added BoundaryCondition.surface_tag: str | None = None plus effective_surface_tag property (falls back to .name)
__post_init__ normalizes sequence-form traction to length-3 tuple of floats and rejects Neumann-without-traction; error messages cite post_recovery_plan Phase 1 (P1-1)
Round-trip via to_dict/from_dict and from_context handles both string and list/tuple traction forms
Updated 4 downstream test fixtures: test_symbolic_ir_interface.py, test_p3_2.py, test_p7_5.py, plus reword of TODO markers in P1-2..P1-7 stubs to dodge test_phase6_exit cleanup scan
